learning_outcomes.text: Students can comprehend, analyze, and evaluate overarching questions regarding lightweight design concepts and constructions, as well as the associated materials and manufacturing processes in the context of sustainability.

Students can methodically grasp, analyze, and evaluate problems by combining management and economic methods with technical engineering methods to later propose correct solutions and make decisions. Further competencies in leadership, communication, self-management, conflict, and change management complete the engineering studies by addressing "soft" aspects, enabling them to successfully manage both the "what" and the "how" in professional life.

syllabus_topics: Methods and tools in lightweight design
Understanding and analyzing economic and management requirements for entrepreneurial decisions
Making and critically questioning entrepreneurial decisions
Evaluating and optimizing procedures in business processes
Utilizing classical consulting approaches and tools
Applying methodological approaches and procedures in change projects
assessment_rules: Due to the different topics and lecture times, the subjects are not examined as a module examination, but individually. Students will receive separate grades for each component (MABB721 and MABB722).
